contentList: \GLOWING SHIELD/ Once per Short Rest, if you are below 50% <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag> and take damage, you gain [1] <LSTag Tooltip="TemporaryHitPoints">temporary hit points</LSTag>. \SHIELD OF SHIELDING/ Must take a Short Rest. \ABSOLUTE'S WARBOARD/ If the wielder is a True Soul or bears the Absolute's Brand, they gain a +[1] bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>. \ABSOLUTE'S PROTECTOR/ If the wielder is a True Soul or bears the Absolute's Brand, all damage received from spells is reduced by [1].
